constraints.unit: Class A average daily departures (ADDs), passenger service; 1 ADD = 365 departures/yr
constraints.notes: 2014 Amendments: max 85 Class A ADDs through 2020, 95 through 2030. 4 Class A ADDs are designated for priority allocation to all-cargo service; two of these may be allocated to passenger service.

constraints.needs_verification: whether 11.21 MAP was served in 2021-2025 and mitigation measures met (then the cap is 12.5 instead of 12.2)
constraints.notes: Phase 3 (2026-2030): 12.2 MAP, or 12.5 MAP if 11.21 MAP was served between 2021-01-01 and 2025-12-31 and certain mitigation measures are met. Earlier: 10.8 MAP through 2020, 11.8 MAP through 2025. Agreement amended in 2003 and 2014; the earlier claim of a 2020 amendment and a curfew to 2035 is not supported by the source page and was removed.

constraints.notes: Statutory perimeter rule limits nonstop flights to 1,250 miles except for a fixed, legislatively-granted set of beyond-perimeter exemptions (10 more added by the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024).
